title: Missing API Authentication
gemini_claim_reference: Backend lacks authentication on API routes
evidence: grep across backend/app found no implementation of Security, Depends(get_current_user), APIKey, or JWT.
recommended_fix: Add API key or JWT middleware to all routers.

title: Prompt Injection Vulnerability
evidence: In _build_scene_plan_prompt, req.brief is injected directly into the prompt without escaping or strict bounds.
reproduction_steps: Send a malicious prompt in the brief payload instructing the model to ignore prior directives.
recommended_fix: Sanitize and limit the length of the brief; use strict JSON enforcement techniques.

title: Integration Tests Failing due to Environment
evidence: pytest execution results in 60 failures, heavily dominated by PermissionError on /storage.
reproduction_steps: Run pytest locally outside of container.
recommended_fix: Mock ARTIFACTS_LOCAL_ROOT to a tmp_path in conftest.py.

title: Hardcoded Secret Defaults
evidence: backend/app/core/config.py contains changeme and phase2-noop-changeme default values.
recommended_fix: Remove defaults and require environment variables to be set.

title: Missing Frontend Tests
gemini_claim_reference: Frontend has no npm test script
reproduction_steps: Run npm run test in frontend directory
recommended_fix: Initialize vitest and add smoke tests.
